changes.comment: useClientAction now takes an options object with onError, so a host can route action failures into its own notification system or suppress them, instead of being given an unsuppressable window.alert. The callback receives an ActionFailure — message plus the action, doctype and recordId it failed on, and the thrown value as cause when the failure was a throw rather than a refused dispatch — because a notification has to say what failed and an object can gain a field later without breaking hosts. Defaults to the existing alert, so nothing changes for a caller that passes no options
